title: Windows 11 preview update results in invalid certificate error - timezone change
creator: evilspoons
content:
Hi there.

I'm in Alberta, where we have recently changed timezones. Note that the CLOCK has not changed yet, as we are still before the date in November when we would "fall back". We were UTC-6 summer and UTC-7 winter. Windows called this "Mountain Time (USA and Canada), but now the "Mountain Time (Alberta)" timezone is in Windows after the 2026-09 Preview Update (KB5124010) (26300.9550).

When connecting to Shaw.ca's IMAP servers, the certificates that were valid prior to the Windows update are now reported as invalid. This has been confirmed across two separate PCs with different email accounts. The data for the certificate LOOKS valid (see screenshot) and is the same before and after the timezone change.

The failure occurred on the latest ESR release of Thunderbird, as well as 156.0 and 157.0 non-ESR.

Thanks :)

content:

title: Problemi di ricezione mail
creator: omega62
content:
Buongiorno, Premetto che faccio gestire a Thunderbird 5 account di posta, 2 di libero.it, 1 con yahoo.com, 1 con gmail.com e 1 pec con le poste, Thunderbird ha sempre funzionato bene ma da qualche settimana non scarica sempre la posta dal server di libero.it, invece gli altri account funzionano benissimo.

Succede che durante la giornata prevalentemente non scarica in automatico la posta dal server di libero.it, se forzo la richiesta manualmente sembra che si colleghi al server ma non preleva nessuna mail nonostante ci siano dei messaggi non scaricati, poi andando a vedere la posta in arrivo 1 o 2 volte al giorno mi ritrovo con qualche messaggio nuovo che ha prelevato dal server (non tutti) . In questi giorni invece appena apro il programma o forzo manualmente la richiesta di mail si apre una finestra che dice di inserire la pass del miei account di libero, le inserisco ma mi dice che sono errate nonostante siano corrette. Cosa posso fare per risolvere il problema? Non vorrei cancellare e reistallare il programma perchè ho delle date in agenda e delle mail e sottocartelle che mi servono.

title: multiple problems with thunderbird handling gmail accounts
creator: joel.kovarsky
content: For the last few months (several updates to Thunderbird) we are having a terrible time with our gmail accounts in Thunderbird. I am not that tech savvy, but so far nothing has worked (including a Thunderbird uninstall and reinstall). All server settings appear fine, and set to OAuth. We get random extra folders, random deleted folders, trouble with getting copies to sent mail (subscribe OK; have to go to Google's webmail site). This ONLY appears to be a problem with our iMac (M1 chip), and is not occurring with our Macbook Air (M2 chip). I've attempted a few other suggestions thrown up online, but I'm reluctant to tamper too much, and we are increasingly forced to rely on the Google webmail site for adequate function while on the iMac (again, MacBook Air is mostly OK).

content:
I had my dad on Thunderbird, and migrated him to Evolution, after your horrible failure. I only wish there was a Mac version, I'm stuck on Thunderbird on my Macs. There are a lot of authors now coming to Linux, that know nothing about it, and don't know how to use apt, so they try that sandboxed shit, not understanding that's why a lot of people are abandoning Windows and Mac in the first place. What you did is complete BS, and unlike some of those newer people moving to Linux, you can't blame ignorance, because you are not new.

title: Norton blocks Thunderbird email due to "expired certificate"

content:
I have Thunderbird installed on Windows 11 along with Norton 360. Today, my connection to the AT&T e-mail server suddenly disconnected and I immediately got a pop-up notification that Norton detected a problem with a security certificate. When I inspected the details, it indicated that the certificate for inbound.att.net had expired (the range of valid dates on the certificate actually listed the current date as the last valid date). After several infuriating calls with AT&T support and Norton support, I figured out that simply disabling Norton e-mail protection allowed me to access my e-mail account.

Multiple web searches on similar issues suggested that since Thunderbird has its own certificate storage, fixing the problem involves locating the Norton certificate file and importing it using Thunderbird's certificate manager. Unfortunately, that solution appears to be applicable for first-time Thunderbird installation, and I when I tried it I was informed that the certificate was already installed. Another web search suggested that I should go to the Authorities tab and remove the entry for "Norton Email Protection". Unfortunately, the entry that I found was for "Norton Web/Mail Shield", which according to at least one source is not the same thing, so I am afraid to remove it.

So my question is has anyone else encountered this same problem, and is the correct approach to remove the Norton Web/Mail Shield authority before importing Norton's certificate file?

title: Custom tags disappearing in all folders after switching views (since Sept 28, 2026)
creator: ig2
content:
Dear Thunderbird Support Team,

I am writing to report an issue with custom message tags in Thunderbird that started occurring around September 28, 2026 (likely following a recent update).

Issue Description: The problem applies to all folders (Inbox, Sent, custom subfolders, etc.) and is strictly isolated to user-created (custom) tags.

When I apply a custom tag to any email, the tag visually attaches to the message. However, as soon as I switch to another folder in the folder pane and then return to the original folder, the custom tag disappears completely.

Key Observations:

No Relation to Filters: This issue happens with regular emails in any folder, with no filters involved.

Custom Tags vs. Default Tags: This affects only custom tags created by the user. Default built-in tags (e.g., Important, Work, To Do) save correctly and persist after switching folders.

Timeline: All custom tags assigned before September 28, 2026, are still preserved correctly on older emails. The issue affects any new attempt to set a custom tag after this date.

Steps to Reproduce:

Select any email in any folder.

Apply a user-created (custom) tag to the email.

Observe that the tag is visually assigned.

Click on any other folder to switch views.

Return to the original folder — the applied custom tag is gone.

Could you please assist in resolving this issue or suggest a fix/workaround? Custom tags are essential for our daily email management.

Thank you for your help and support.

Best regards,

Ihor Hirnyi E-mail: ig@zrn.com.ua

Windows 11, Dell laptop, Thunderbird Meadow 153.4.0, yahoo mail configured as pop3 (i like to keep messages on my laptop).
